note: The closest match to the stated ICP in this batch. Successful is unambiguous — he owns and runs a construction company, which is the exact profile the ICP quote names. Income holds on behaviour: he called $6,000 'a drop in the bucket over the long haul', paid a deposit within seconds of being asked, and considered running it through the business. Neglected health is textbook: the business consumes his capacity and his health is what has been let slide — high stress, stress eating, and 'I don't have the mental capacity with everything else I've got going on in life to come up with a plan.' He is not the excluded profile either: he works physically, plays soccer, owns kettlebells and has just joined a gym. The one genuine miss is good-to-great — at 225 lb against a 190 target he has not been under in a decade, with recurring back episodes and measurable strength loss, this is closer to arresting a decline than to moving from good to excellent. Recorded as core because four of five criteria are met squarely and the fifth is a matter of degree. Worth noting the pattern: the batch's best ICP fit is also one of only two calls where a deposit was taken.
